claim: Issue ISS-0124 reports that after the v3.16.2 rollout the place-order endpoint error rate rose from under 1% to roughly 46% across all regions and platforms.

evidence.title: Place order returns HTTP 500 since checkout-service v3.16.2
evidence.body: After the v3.16.2 rollout the place-order endpoint fails for a large share of carts. Error rate on POST /orders went from under 1% to roughly 46%. Stack trace points at the new validation code. Affects all regions and platforms. Rollback under discussion.

claim: Payment attempts fell from about 18,000 to 10,209 on 2024-03-14 while the payment failure rate stayed near 2.9%, so the loss happened before payment rather than at the provider.
Android sessions stayed near normal while conversion fell from about 7.6% to about 3.2% and checkout starts did not drop, so users reached checkout but could not complete it.
Conversion fell from about 8.3% on 2024-06-01 to about 6.6% on 2024-06-02 through 2024-06-04 while sessions stayed near normal levels.
Paid search sessions fell from 55322 on 2024-07-11 to 32545 on 2024-07-12 and 27002 on 2024-07-13, while paid search conversion stayed near 0.083.
Checkout starts stayed near normal levels on 2024-09-30 while payment attempts fell to about 14,300 and conversion dropped to 6.2% from about 8.3%.

evidence.body: A DNS provider problem makes our domain fail to resolve for many users in APAC. Sessions from the region dropped. No impact elsewhere.
